important_rules: Use the exact same literal Ambroxol input SMILES in both generator requests.
Canonicalize molecules only in the common downstream evaluation pipeline.
Do not enable server-side uniqueness filtering; duplicates must remain observable.
Do not enable server-side structural filtering; common downstream filters are applied after generation.
Do not remove invalid, duplicate, or low-quality outputs before saving raw responses.
Save raw API response before any RDKit processing.
Do not tune parameters between replicates.
Existing GenMol 3x1000 runs are a separate scaling/uniqueness stress test, not part of the primary 3x100 comparison.

known_native_objective_difference.GenMol: QED is used by the NIM as the output scoring/ranking method; temperature/noise govern sampling.
known_native_objective_difference.MolMIM: CMA-ES actively optimizes QED while enforcing min_similarity=0.3.
known_native_objective_difference.analysis_rule: Do not claim the internal optimization objectives are equivalent. Compare returned candidates using the common downstream evaluator and requested-molecule denominator.

pilot_vs_primary.reason: GenMol documentation states quality depends on temperature/noise. The primary run therefore uses documented NIM defaults rather than an already-observed exploratory parameter setting.
